articles.headline: Socceroos transfer tracker: Where Australia's stars will play in 2026-27
articles.description: There's nothing like a World Cup to put young stars in the shop window! With that in mind, ESPN has assembled a list of all the Socceroos' post-tournament transfers, all in one place.

articles.headline: UEFA boss Aleksander Čeferin rules out FIFA presidency bid
articles.description: UEFA president Aleksander Čeferin has ruled himself out of the running to replace FIFA chief Gianni Infantino, but Čeferin warned the beleaguered FIFA boss that he must either quit or face a leadership challenge in March.

articles.headline: New season, new haircut: Erling Haaland ditches iconic long hair for new season
articles.description: Erling Haaland shared his latest viral social media post, showing him cutting his long blonde hair in favour of a buzz cut.

articles.headline: Messi tracker: Goals, assists, key moments in 2026
articles.description: ESPN provides game-by-game analysis of Lionel Messi's performances for Inter Miami and Argentina.

articles.headline: England name Women's Under-20 World Cup squad despite European boycott threat
articles.description: England have named their squad for the Women's Under-20 World Cup, despite the threat of a European boycott still hanging over the tournament.

articles.headline: Paredes banned 10 games as Argentina punished for World Cup final brawl
articles.description: FIFA banned three Argentina players on Friday, including a 10-match suspension for midfielder Leandro Paredes, for striking Spain opponents after losing the World Cup final.
